paragraphs.text:
You try to convince the officer that you have a particularly good 
reason for needing access to the file, but he simply doesn’t care. 
“Scram, stranger, you’re ruining my smoke. If you want to dig at the 
dead guy, go bother his widow. Her place is over on the north side of 
town, right next to the church. Can’t damn well miss it.”
Officer Powell will be of no more help at this time.
• To go find the Harris house, go to 90.
• To return to the hotel, go to 122.
